title: Chapter 734
text:
After witnessing the performance of the four of them, everyone started to believe that they were gods. This seemed to be the only explanation for their unprecedented strength.

Ta ta ta!

Just when everyone was in a daze, the royal guards of the Ocean Kingdom arrived. They were originally following Vosumede's orders to surround the wizards in the gathering center. However, Vosumede was already dead, and the royal mages were also frightened by the four 'deities' to the point that they lost the courage to resist.

Vosumede's subordinates surrendered one after another, and the leader of the royal guards was in disbelief when he learned that Vosumede had died. However, after confirming that there was no mistake with the corpse, he was overjoyed.

Vosumede was not supported by ordinary people, and many wished for him to die. However, none of them had the ability to kill him. Thus, Vosumede's death was a piece of good news for some people.

The leader of the royal guards initially thought that it was the mages of the assembly who killed Vosumede. However, the truth from the mouth of the wizards gave him a shock, and he could not help but size up the four 'gods' with respect and suspicion in his eyes. He then hurriedly sent his subordinates to inform the king.

At this moment, the night was dark, and the atmosphere was strange. Almost everyone was sizing up the four of them. Han Xiao did not care about the reactions of the people around him and only focused on looking at the mission completion on his interface.

After completing the chain mission, the Demon King of Planet Nalun, he had finally obtained the talent reward.

+ 20 Mental Resistance to Spirit Lock. Duration of all negative mental effects reduced by 10%. When receiving a mental attack, you have 18 – 34% chances of being immune to the attack. When the immunity takes effect, there is a cooldown of 30 minutes before the next immunity can be triggered.

"Together with my Advanced Mental Toughness, my mental resistance is increased by a total of 55%. Compared to my resistance, this immunity effect can be used in some situations …"

Han Xiao nodded.

Although the cooldown time was very long, and it could only be triggered once in a battle, and it couldn't be controlled by the user, it was still a very useful ability. If he had this talent when facing Sisko's psychic weapon, he might be able to be immune to a Beyond Grade A mental attack.

The probability of triggering the immunity effect was at least 18%. Even if his luck was slightly lower, it was still barely acceptable. Han Xiao was already used to seeing the lower limit of the probability at first glance.

At this time, Tomar had already informed everyone about the 'divine names' of Han Xiao and the other three. Wulis brought everyone in front of Han Xiao, and his expression was uneasy. It was as though he didn't know how to communicate with a divine being. This was the first time he had come into contact with a divine being that surpassed his level of existence, and his heart was filled with fear and trepidation.

"Sirs … Err, deities, I represent all Magi to thank you for getting rid of Vosumede. If you have any requests, I will do my best to fulfill them …"

Han Xiao kept his interface and looked at the nervous crowd. With a smile, he said, "I do have a request. Tomar is the missionary that I have chosen, and I will bring him to Scandinavia."

A missionary of the gods?!

Everyone turned to look at Tomar. Their eyes were filled with envy, astonishment, and all sorts of emotions.

Tomar opened his mouth wide, and his mind went blank. He pointed at himself in disbelief and stuttered, "This … What does this mean …"

"It means that I will bring you to the world of the gods." Han Xiao continued to act and asked, "Are you willing?"

Tomar was so shocked that he couldn't speak coherently. A few words came out of his mouth, and he nodded his head frantically. It was as though he was testing if he could break his neck.

Wulis swallowed a mouthful of saliva. He was filled with curiosity toward the divine being and Scandinavia. However, he didn't know the personality of the divine being and didn't dare to ask.

Right at this time, the soldier that went to inform the king finally returned and reported the situation to the leader of the royal guards.

Following which, the leader of the royal guards came before Han Xiao and the others with a respectful expression.

"Four deities, Your Excellency Wulis, Your Excellency Tomar, His Majesty wishes to meet with all of you."

Wulis did not reply but turned to look at Han Xiao. Clearly, he knew that the king wanted to meet the divine beings.

Han Xiao thought for a while before nodding and agreeing to the invitation.

It wouldn't take much time for them to meet the king of the natives, and it could also dispel Tomar's worries.

Upon seeing this, Wulis and Tomar agreed as well.

"Everyone, please follow me."

The leader of the royal guards was overjoyed and brought the six of them to the main hall.

The king of the Ocean Kingdom had already put on his royal attire and was about to meet everyone.

Facing a being that seemed to be a divine being, the king of the Ocean Kingdom tried his best to appear dignified. This was the first time he came into contact with a divine being, and he didn't wish to tarnish the kingdom's glory. However, his fat belly had ruined his attempts.

When he saw that Han Xiao and the others were disguised as Naluns, the nervousness in his heart dissipated. At the very least, the appearance of the divine being was familiar.

"Honorable divine being, I welcome all of you on behalf of the Ocean Kingdom. Forgive me for being presumptuous, but please allow me to ask, what exactly are divine beings and what is your goal?"

"Even if I tell you, you won't be able to understand our level of existence." Han Xiao raised his brows and continued, "As for our goal, our first goal is to eliminate Vosumede, and that has already been accomplished. Our second goal is to choose a missionary, and Tomar is my candidate."

The king of the Ocean Kingdom took a look at Tomar and memorized his appearance. "In that case, the four of you wish to spread your religion?"

"Oh, you can understand it that way." Han Xiao nodded. This was a more convenient reason.

The eyes of the king of the Ocean Kingdom lit up. He felt that he had grasped the need of the divine being.

"Since that's the case, if the four of you are able to perform miracles and protect the Ocean Kingdom, I am willing to establish a religion that belongs to you and mobilize all the citizens of the kingdom to become your believers."

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and wasn't too surprised. To a backward civilization, knowing the existence of the divine being was equivalent to a chance to reshape the structure of their society. In their eyes, the help of the divine being was more important than the development of technology.

He could predict that through his influence, the development of Planet Nalun would change, and the religious authority would start to interfere with politics. There was a high chance that a political system would be formed.

Right at this moment, a new mission popped up on his interface.

Perform Miracles

Mission Introduction: The native government of Planet Nalun regards you as a divine being and wishes for you to perform 'miracles'. Perhaps you will leave your footprints in the history of this civilization.

Mission Requirements: Perform a 'miracle' that will make the king of the Ocean Kingdom gasp in shock.

Reward: 300 Experience, 1 Planet Legendary Point.

"Oh my, there's still a side mission." Han Xiao was pleasantly surprised.

In his previous life, in order to obtain Legendary Points, the players in the later versions would occasionally go to backward civilizations to perform miracles. Leaving one's name in the history of a civilization was also a way to obtain Legendary Points.

Since he could obtain Legendary Points, Han Xiao didn't mind completing this mission.

Glancing at the expectant expressions of the King, Ulis, and Tomar, Han Xiao pondered for a while before waving his hand. Nanoparticles formed countless carving knives and quickly carved a map on the wall of the palace.

"What are you doing …" The king of the Ocean Kingdom was stunned. He thought that the miracle would be very shocking, but he didn't expect it to be so simple.

"This is the original appearance of the world that you are in, and the map of the entire world," Han Xiao said slowly.

The map on the wall was the one that Philip had created.

The king of the Ocean Kingdom was shocked. He quickly looked at the map carefully and exclaimed, "The earth is actually round?"

Even Ulis and Tomar had shocked expressions on their faces.

Currently, Planet Nalun only occupied one continent and had not explored the entire world. People didn't even know that the planet under their feet was a sphere.

"Wait a minute, there are two other continents outside of our continent?" The king of the Ocean Kingdom saw the key point and held his breath.

The Ocean Kingdom was only one of the kingdoms on Planet Nalun. There were other kingdoms competing with them. If the other two uninhabited continents really existed, the kingdom would be able to take the initiative and set foot on the other two continents to expand according to this map.

When he thought of the possibility of expanding his territory, the king of the Ocean Kingdom was so excited that he could almost hear his heart beating loudly.

Suddenly, the king of the Ocean Kingdom realized that this map might not be correct. This was because he had no way of knowing the true appearance of the world. Even if this was a lie from the gods, he couldn't expose it.

The king of the Ocean Kingdom couldn't help but have doubts. He coughed and asked carefully, "Dear God, how can I verify the authenticity of this map? You know, we are all insignificant mortals. We don't have the ability to cross the ocean outside of this continent to explore the world."

The mission hasn't been completed yet … Han Xiao frowned slightly and quickly relaxed. He thought about it and said, "That's right. Then I'll let you see it for yourself."

"See it for myself?" The king of the Ocean Kingdom was stunned.

Before he could react, Han Xiao grabbed his shoulder and formed a life-saving shield for him with nanoparticles.

Bang!

In the next second, Han Xiao grabbed him and soared into the sky, smashing through the dome of the palace.

They rose rapidly and soon reached the edge of the atmosphere. From here, they could barely see half of the planet.

"There, do you see it? The world is round, and the two continents are there …"

Han Xiao said casually and turned to look at the king of the Ocean Kingdom. He saw that the king was so scared that his face was pale. His eyes were blank, and his whole body was numb. It was as if he had lost the ability to react to the outside world.

"It seems like it's too exciting for him …"

Helplessly shaking his head, Han Xiao brought him back to the palace. The whole process took less than a minute.

When Han Xiao took off, Wulis and Tomar were already dumbfounded. Seeing the two of them return, the two of them were dumbfounded. They finally understood that they had underestimated the strength of the gods. The strength of the gods was not something that they could understand.

Han Xiao gave the king of the Ocean Kingdom a dose of refreshment. Only then did the king come back to his senses. His legs went soft, and he sat on the ground, unable to maintain his dignity. He stared at Han Xiao in shock, unable to say a word.

Before this, he still had some doubts about the identities of the four "gods," but now, he no longer had any doubts. His bladder, which was on the verge of incontinence, replaced his brain, allowing his body to remember the fact that "gods" were omnipotent.

"Do you believe it now?" Han Xiao laughed.

"I believe it, I believe it …" The king of the Ocean Kingdom nodded. In addition to respect, there was fanaticism and piety in his eyes.

This was a miracle!

At this moment, he felt that he had finally found his faith.

A notification popped up on Han Xiao's interface. The mission of displaying a miracle had been completed, and he had obtained 1 Legendary Point.

He had obtained an additional Legendary Point … Han Xiao smiled inwardly.

…

After the king of the Ocean Kingdom promised to establish a religion for the four of them, Han Xiao and the rest left the palace, disappearing from everyone's sight.

As for Tomar, he had become a member of the group. He had already agreed to follow Han Xiao to the 'Kingdom of God'. He was a typical orphan type protagonist, and he had no attachments. Thus, he left in a carefree manner.

Han Xiao felt that bringing Tomar along with him was a good thing for the Planet Nalun. Tomar was the first person from the Planet Nalun to enter the universe, just like himself.

As for Tomar, he was a complete native, and it was a good opportunity for him to see the world and understand the true appearance of the universe.

After he received systematic nurturing and unleashed his talent to the greatest extent, he would be able to use the resources he obtained from the universe to nourish the Planet Nalun. The benefits he would bring to the Mother Planet would far surpass what he had achieved in his previous life.

The mission had already ended, and Han Xiao did not stay on the Planet Nalun for long. He brought everyone onto the spaceship and left the planet.

Tomar was curious about everything on the spaceship. At the same time, he felt a little lost. He felt that the image of a god was different from what he had imagined.

Han Xiao directly threw him to Fu Ding, allowing Fu Ding to complete the initial education.

He returned to his room alone and looked through the information that he had accumulated over the past half a month.

After skimming through the daily affairs of the army, Han Xiao looked through his communicator and suddenly found a message from Harrofal.

They had not contacted each other for seven years, and Han Xiao was somewhat curious as to why Harrofal was looking for him.

However, after taking a look, his expression changed.

The message was short, but the content caused his heart to tremble. There was a sentence written without any head or tail.
